name: windstack-sdk

scripts.format: biome format --write packages/*/src scripts package.json package-lock.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.base.json packages/*/package.json packages/*/tsconfig.json specs/wisp-provider-contract.json biome.json
scripts.format:check: biome format packages/*/src scripts package.json package-lock.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.base.json packages/*/package.json packages/*/tsconfig.json specs/wisp-provider-contract.json biome.json
scripts.build:native: tsc -b packages/core packages/crypto packages/abi packages/rpc packages/contract packages/account packages/antelope packages/signing-request packages/session
scripts.build: tsc -b packages/core packages/evm packages/solana packages/crypto packages/abi packages/rpc packages/contract packages/account packages/antelope packages/signing-request packages/vexanium packages/wallet-plugin-wisp packages/session
scripts.pack:native: npm run clean && npm run build:native && npm pack --dry-run -w @windstack/core -w @windstack/crypto -w @windstack/abi -w @windstack/rpc -w @windstack/contract -w @windstack/account -w @windstack/antelope -w @windstack/signing-request -w @windstack/session
scripts.test: node scripts/test-signing.mjs && node scripts/test-provider-contract.mjs && node scripts/test-provider-spec.mjs && node scripts/test-wisp-session-restore.mjs && node scripts/test-wisp-telegram-transport.mjs && node scripts/test-sdk-behavior.mjs && npm run test:native && node scripts/test-general-purpose.mjs
scripts.test:native: node scripts/test-crypto.mjs && node scripts/test-abi.mjs && node scripts/test-rpc.mjs && node scripts/test-contract-account.mjs && node scripts/test-antelope-client.mjs && node scripts/test-signing-request.mjs && node scripts/test-windswap-signing-request.mjs && node scripts/test-session.mjs && node scripts/test-native-antelope.mjs && node scripts/test-vexanium-abi.mjs
scripts.validate:native: npm run clean && npm run format:check && npm run check:release && npm run build:native && npm run test:native && npm run pack:native
scripts.validate: npm run clean && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run check:release && npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run pack:dry-run
scripts.release:dry-run: npm run validate && npm run audit:release && npm run verify:vexanium && npm audit && npm run audit:native

author: Gilang Ramadan
description: Modern TypeScript SDK for Vexanium applications, wallet connectivity, contracts, transactions, VSR, VEX EVM, and reusable chain primitives.
